issues.quote: Many people reuse passwords, and that's normal.
issues.why: 'Many' is vague, and the line could be read as a judgement about the viewer's own habits, which the brief's warm, non-preachy tone is meant to avoid.
issues.fix: Lots of people reuse passwords, and it's an easy habit to fall into.

issues.quote: SafeNest has a shared family vault, so you keep them all in one place.
issues.why: The brief's main benefit includes the 'Check this message' tool for suspicious texts, but the script only mentions the password vault.
issues.fix: SafeNest has a shared family vault, plus a Check this message tool for suspicious texts, all in one place.
